title: Lightly Fried Northern Thai Noodles Nam Prik
description: A quick-fix Thai dish featuring noodles and a spicy nam prik sauce, lightly fried to create a shattering texture, this recipe is a perfect representation of Northern Thai cuisine and is Buddhist-temple-friendly.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts and cook for another 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the nam prik sauce and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the rice noodles to the wok or frying pan, stirring to combine with the nam prik sauce and tofu mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are lightly fried and starting to shatter.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and top with chopped scallions, fried shallots, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve immediately, with additional lime wedges on the side.
Garnish with additional scallions and fried shallots if desired.
